title: EQ IV

content:
Parametric 4-band (filtered) stereo equaliser module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) with crossover frequencies settings, an optional low-cut (15hz) and minimalist OLED VU-meters.

press aux to show the revision number and global CPU usage

#1 copy eq4_1-5.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install eq4_1-5.zop"

v1.5 now installed into /media/orac/usermodules/fx , press aux to show infos

v1.4 is now only stereo (no more eq4/eq4s) with a bugfix : there was an issue when having more than one in a rack.
